note: Drop Community Edition 2.670 measurements into the override fields. Shield scale (1:1) and 4-to-6 pairing are measured (CE in-battle capture 2026-11-24; Shield Total = S1 + 2*S2_6 + 2*S3_5 + S4 held on all 1,157 CE rows). Turn-mode yaw letters absent from measuredMaxYawPerTick keep today's fallback and emit turnModeUnverified. No code change is required to replace a fallback.

shields.sideColumnFactorNote: Measured 1:1 per facing (factor 1), no x2 (CE in-battle capture 2026-11-24). Note: the CE Vessel Library screen is unreliable for shields (some rear values, e.g. on D7/POL/E4 rows, disagree with the table); the in-battle six-segment ring and the shiplist table agree.
shields.pairingNote: Measured (CE in-battle capture 2026-11-24): facing 0 (front) = Shield 1; facings 1 and 5 (front right, front left) = Shield 2 _ 6 (shieldForwardSide); facings 2 and 4 (rear right, rear left) = Shield 3 _ 5 (shieldAftSide); facing 3 (rear) = Shield 4. Indexes are shield facings, 0 = front, clockwise.

turnYaw.measuredNote: Keys are the letters AA and A–G. A value is max yaw per tick for that letter. A letter with a value uses it and does not emit turnModeUnverified. Letters left out keep the shared fallback.
